analysis_notes: Measured from the licensed 48 kHz WAVs (full mix + DRUMS/BASS/INSTRUMENTS stems) and the vocal-stem preview with librosa + faster-whisper small.en.

Song form: 4.4-24.4 voice + acoustic only; 24.45 bass enters; 75.1-77.6 vocal-free breath bar with an instrument pull-back at 76.9; 77.612 drums enter for the first time (biggest lift in the song); 97.20 one-beat drum stop under 'You're the'; 97.83 drums return on 'ROSE'; 100.36 'garden' resolves on the tonic (B); 115.5-117.6 drum drop under 'That I love you'; 196.371 final downbeat, B chord rings out to 201.1.
Vocal and instrumental versions are sample-aligned (1-sample lag), so the instrumental can replace the vocal mix at any point without a timing jump.
Whisper word times ran up to 0.6 s early in the chorus, so vocal anchors below come from vocal-stem onsets.
